snippet.title: SPELLCASTERS CHRONICLES ARENA TRAILER | MAUSOLEUM
snippet.description:
Discover a gate between worlds, the crucible of destiny: the Mausoleum arena!

Our Closed Beta weekend will be held inside those ancient walls, and the first Spellcasters will battle it out in the house of the ancestors’ relics!

Closed Beta starts on December 4! Register here: https://qdlink.co/ClosedBeta

More information on https://www.spellcasterschronicles.com

Join our Discord community - https://discord.gg/DvxyTcQxpy
